full_prompt_en: A square noir-like painting shows a nearly empty night street and a lone person outside a dim storefront in a weathered blue building. Most of the upper half is deep black-blue sky, interrupted by a small pale moon near the left of center. The building takes up the middle and right, its large turquoise wall stained, scuffed, and unevenly lit. At street level, a warm storefront window and a narrow dark door sit below the wide blank wall. Small indistinct notices and goods appear behind the glass, but their details remain blurred. A red illuminated sign projects from the building on the left; its large pale letters read "WANE", while smaller lettering beneath is too soft to make out. The person stands near the window in a blue coat and dark trousers, shown at a distance, with face details unresolved. Farther left, a low red car is parked where the building gives way to deep shadow. A tall curved streetlamp stands just right of the shop, casting a cool white pool onto the turquoise wall and a little of the sidewalk. The foreground is a broad gray roadway left almost empty, with a narrow pale curb running across its upper edge. This wide horizontal expanse sets the isolated figure and shop at a distance from the viewer. Warm yellow light from within the shop makes a small pocket of human activity against the blue-green wall; the moon and lamp supply colder accents above. Grainy paint and rough wall texture show through the dark areas, while the building edges soften into the night. The overall composition is spare and tense, using the contrast between black negative space, cold turquoise surface, and a tiny warm window to create urban solitude.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑色电影感绘画呈现一条几乎空荡的夜街，一人站在一座风化蓝色建筑的昏暗店面外。上半幅大部分是深黑蓝夜空，中央偏左一轮小小浅月打破黑暗。建筑占据中部和右侧，大块青绿墙面布满污渍、擦痕，受光不匀。街面高度，一扇暖光店窗和一道窄深色门位于宽阔空墙下。玻璃后有模糊的小告示与货物，细节无法辨清。红色发光招牌从建筑左侧挑出，较大的浅色字母写着“WANE”，下方更小文字太软而无法读出。人物穿蓝色外套和深色裤子站在窗旁，距离较远，脸部细节不清。更左侧，一辆低矮红车停在建筑转入深影的地方。高而弯曲的路灯立在店面右侧，把冷白光池投到青绿色墙面和少量人行道上。前景是一大片几乎空白的灰色车道，上缘横过一道窄浅色路沿。这片宽阔水平空间把孤立人物与店铺推离观者。店内暖黄光在蓝绿墙面中形成微小的人间活动区域；月亮和路灯在上方提供较冷重音。颗粒状颜料和粗糙墙面肌理穿过深色区，建筑边缘融进夜里。整体构图精简而紧张，以黑色留白、冷青绿表面与微小暖窗的对照营造城市孤独感。
style_prompt_en: Noir-like painterly imagery uses large pools of blue-black negative space, a cool turquoise middle value, and a few tightly contained red and amber accents. Sparse hard light creates isolated luminous patches rather than evenly revealing the whole frame. One broad weathered plane carries scratches, stains, grain, and uneven paint, so its apparent simplicity remains tactile. Small details gather around the brightest opening, while the outer areas fall into deep shadow and soft-edged darkness. A wide horizontal foreground increases distance and makes a tiny focal silhouette feel isolated. Cool overhead illumination and warmer interior glow form a restrained two-source color structure. Edges sharpen around illuminated rectangles and thin verticals, then fade into the dark elsewhere. The overall effect is cinematic, quiet, and slightly uneasy, achieving atmosphere through selective visibility and careful distribution of light.
style_prompt_zh: 黑色电影感的绘画影像使用大片蓝黑留白、冷青绿中间明度，以及少量紧紧收住的红与琥珀重音。稀疏硬光形成孤立的亮区，而非平均照开整幅画面。一片宽阔风化色面带划痕、污渍、颗粒和不均匀颜料，使看似简洁的区域仍有触感。小细节聚在最亮开口附近，外围落入深影与软边黑暗。宽阔水平前景增加距离，使小小焦点剪影显得孤立。冷色顶光与较暖内部光构成克制的双光源配色结构。发亮矩形和细竖线附近边缘变清楚，其余则融入黑暗。整体效果有电影感、安静且微微不安，凭选择性可见度与细心分配的光营造气氛。
theme_en: A lone person outside a dim storefront on a blue night street
theme_zh: 蓝色夜街上，一人站在昏暗店面外
name: Glen Orbik
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
